scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @psc/server" "npm run dev -w @psc/web"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build -w @psc/web && npm run start -w @psc/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @psc/server && npm run test -w @psc/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
